Definition: from G2095 and G5345; well spoken of, i.e. reputable:--of good report.
BiblicalUsage: eúphēmos is a plain word for of good report. In Philippians 4:8, the text says "whatsoever things [are] of good report."
TheologicalSignificance: This one, eúphēmos, I take at face value: of good report.
